create_hdf5_matrix

Source: R/label_propagation.R
create_hdf5_matrix.Rd

Create a chunked HDF5 matrix for streaming label-spreading output

Preallocates a compressed HDF5 dataset (default name "prob") for storing class-probability blocks streamed from label_spreading_blocked.

Usage

create_hdf5_matrix(
  h5file,
  dataset = "prob",
  nrow,
  ncol,
  chunk_rows = 4096,
  chunk_cols = 128
)

Arguments

h5file

Output HDF5 file path.

dataset

Dataset name to create.

nrow, ncol

Dimensions of the dataset.

chunk_rows, chunk_cols

Chunk sizes for row/column blocks.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE after successful creation.

Details

Removes any existing file before creation. Uses gzip compression (level = 7) and double precision storage.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_hdf5_matrix("prob_out.h5", "prob", nrow = 5000, ncol = 256)
} # }
